fixes.explanation: Seated, baker! Paul says God "…raised us up with Christ and seated us with Him in the heavenly realms in Christ Jesus…" (Ephesians 2:6). Raised up and seated, both with Christ, in the heavenly realms. That comes right after Paul says God made us alive with Christ (Ephesians 2:5). So the picture goes from alive, to raised up, to seated, all with Christ.

True, baker. Paul says salvation is "…not by works, so that no one can boast." (Ephesians 2:9). Not by works, and the reason is right there in the verse: no one can boast. Right before that, Paul says it's by grace through faith, and that it's the gift of God (Ephesians 2:8).
